description: This source file defines the internal implementation of the GrainDirectoryPartition class in Orleans Runtime, including methods for registering, looking up, and deregistering grain addresses, along with their associated logging mechanisms.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryPartition
classes.description: Internal sealed partial class implementing grain directory partition management within Orleans Runtime, handling registration, lookup, and deregistration of grain addresses, with logging support.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a grain address asynchronously, ensuring membership version validity and ownership.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Looks up a grain address asynchronously by grain ID, ensuring membership version validity and ownership.

methods.name: DeregisterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deregisters a grain address, validating ownership and membership version.

methods.name: DeregisterCore
methods.description: Core logic to remove a grain address from the directory, considering if the silo is dead.

methods.name: LookupCore
methods.description: Core logic to retrieve a grain address from the directory if available and alive.

methods.name: RegisterCore
methods.description: Core logic to register or update a grain address in the directory, respecting the current membership version and replacing dead entries.

methods.name: IsSiloDead
methods.description: Checks if the silo associated with the grain address is dead based on the cluster membership snapshot.

methods.name: LogRegisterAsync
methods.description: Logging method invoked when registering a grain address.

methods.name: LogLookupAsync
methods.description: Logging method invoked when looking up a grain address.

methods.name: LogDeregisterAsync
methods.description: Logging method invoked when deregistering a grain address.
